title: Global lie-flat rankings for every airline
description: A scored ranking of long-haul first and business class products by seat privacy, service, ground experience, and fleet consistency.

entries.why: Three-room suite with living room, bedroom and shower—unmatched private space and near-perfect scores across all factors.
Enclosed 1-1-1-1 suite with armchair + chaise/bed; near-perfect privacy and CDG La Première ground still class-leading.
1-1 suite with separate swivel chair and bed; center pairs combine into doubles; elite SQ soft product and consistency.
Floor-to-ceiling enclosure and vast space; center suites get virtual windows; shower spa access rounds out the product.
Allegris double suite: private two-person cabin, climate control and LH First ground; limited early rollout.
Separate armchair and bed-scale bench plus shower access; huge apartment space short of The Residence.
Allegris-derived double suite with SWISS polish; early Senses First subfleet still limits consistency.
Private suite with shower and onboard bar; slightly less private than Game Changer but outstanding consistency.
Huge 1-1 enclosed suite with multi-mode seating and standout JAL bedding; ground slightly behind Gulf peers.
Allegris single suite: very spacious enclosed cabin and strong sleep ergonomics; First ground at FRA/MUC elite.
Wide fully enclosed first suite plus top-tier ANA service and bedding; 1-2-1 vs pure 1-1 peers.
Qsuite remains the business benchmark: doors, couple/quad configs, Qatar service and unmatched network reach.
High-privacy enclosed first seat with SWISS onboard execution; early Senses First subfleet caveat.
Sofa-like business suite and among the widest beds flying; doors plus ANA service polish.
Open first suite: exceptionally wide bed and refined CX service; privacy trails fully enclosed peers.
Legacy La Première still a total-journey standout via CDG ground and AF soft product; curtain privacy is dated.
Open first: very wide seat-bed and elite SQ service; privacy weaker than newer enclosed first suites.
Excellent bed, bedding and service; open layout is the main age-related privacy gap.
Enclosed first suite with elite ANA soft product; limited to Honolulu Flying Honu subfleet.
Classic enclosed first suite with strong amenities; smaller and less private than Game Changer.
Enclosed first suite with strong Etihad dining and bedding; large private cabin short of First Apartments.
1-2-1 business suite: spacious, private and sleep-focused; newer product with growing consistency.
Allegris Business Suite: large enclosed front-row suite with minibar and excellent sleep space; rollout ongoing.
Excellent enclosed suite plus above-average SWISS service polish; early Senses Business footprint.
AF door suite with strong food, bedding and broad fleet rollout; privacy slightly behind top Gulf suites.
Classic LH first: superb lounges and FRA/MUC ground; open hard product privacy is now clearly dated.
Excellent bed and SYD/LAX ground; open first suites trail newer enclosed products on privacy.
Superb Qatar service and lounges; spacious but open hard product lacks suite doors.
Wide bed, center double-bed option and elite SQ consistency; not a full door suite.
Among the best modern first hard products; smaller network and ground footprint hold the score back.
Enclosed narrow-body first suite: remarkably private with strong Etihad soft product; limited fleet.
Very good bed and service with strong ZRH ground; open suites limit the privacy score.
Refined door suite with excellent ergonomics and Cathay service; Aria retrofit still expanding.
Private, well-designed suite with strong Etihad dining and bedding; growing Business Studio footprint.
Meaningful privacy upgrade plus strong LHR First lounges; door First not yet fleetwide.
Private wide enclosed first suites; strong Korean catering and solid consistency.
Adient Ascent door suite with excellent Qatar service; smaller footprint than flagship Qsuite.
Refined enclosed seat with strong tech and privacy; new airline ground still maturing.
Excellent suite design, bedding and service; limited network and ground hold the score.
Most spacious narrow-body business seat—guest bench and door; Mint ground footprint is modest.
198 cm flat bed, aisle access and privacy door; strong bedding/LHR ground, mixed Club Suite rollout.
Reliable door suite, good bedding and broad long-haul availability; solid Delta One consistency.
Well-proportioned door suite with excellent Etihad soft product on the new long-haul retrofit.
Open first with Cathay-style wide seat plus Qatar service; fleet consistency weaker than flagship First.
Large front-row double suites with ottoman seating and Virgin’s social cabin product.
Allegris Extra-Space: exceptional personal space without full Suite enclosure; strong LH ground support.
Excellent personal space with polished SWISS service; short of full suite doors.
Modern door suite with excellent storage; AA service inconsistency caps the Flagship Suite score.
Strong new direct-aisle seat and elite IFE; no privacy door versus suite peers.
Window seats deliver exceptional privacy and bed width despite the nominal 2-2-2 layout.
Private window seats and excellent Qatar service; aisle access and layout vary by type.
Extremely wide seat and elite SQ service; angled sleep position divides opinion.
True lie-flat first suites remain, but Indonesian press: only PK-GIF actively sells first; often blocked.
Excellent private suite seat and Turkish catering; tiny Horizon Suite subfleet hurts consistency.
Very good bed and soft product across the latest reverse-herringbone fleet; no privacy door.
Modern door suite with strong Malaysian catering; privacy improving as the new subfleet grows.
Excellent all-round conventional reverse-herringbone with strong Cathay soft product.
Enclosed narrow-body business suite: outstanding privacy and strong Etihad soft product.
Polished door suite with good bedding and reliable Iberia Next availability.
Front-row business suite: former first-class seat with exceptional space, sold as business.
Super Diamond reverse-herringbone plus Qatar service; excellent conventional seat across many types.
Intimate 14-seat all-aisle cabin, beds to 6'7"; strong ground, but still an early six-jet Signature fleet of 30 ordered.
Private direct-aisle narrow-body suite with true flat bed; Flagship Suite rollout still early.
Former first suites sold as business: superb hard product but limited Asiana subfleet.
Good bed and LHR ground; relatively exposed open seat versus newer door First.
Huge front-row double space and excellent value; soft product is not top-tier.
Modern 1-2-1 direct-aisle retrofit with Emirates soft product; incomplete fleet rollout.
Modern door suite with solid Dutch service; rollout still varies by long-haul fleet.
Comfortable spacious open first; privacy trails Kosmo Suites 2.0 enclosed product.
Major privacy and design upgrade over earlier Korean Prestige business products.
Excellent sleep length and direct aisle access; not a full enclosed Allegris suite.
Outstanding window-seat privacy and generous bed space with solid Oman Air soft product.
Very large front-row door suite; Elevated Polaris Studio fleet availability is limited.
Excellent solo high-privacy window seat with polished SWISS Senses service.
Still highly competitive reverse-herringbone with strong CX soft product despite its age.
Excellent solo privacy and aisle access without the Allegris Suite surcharge.
Private, stylish staggered business with consistently strong Starlux service.
Excellent bar, IFE and service; seat width and footwell vary by position.
Excellent EVA service, bedding and a strong conventional 1-2-1 flat bed.
Unique sofa-like fixed-shell bed with exceptional space and fleetwide Finnair consistency.
Excellent window privacy and wide bed across staggered Apex Prestige cabins.
Premium 24-seat 1-1 layout with doors and 180° bed; fleet exposure still very small.
Strong new all-aisle seat with excellent SWISS service; no suite door.
Door suite with a genuine two-metre bed; hard product strong, soft/ground more modest.

Aeroflot-style door suite: excellent hard product; Air India execution improving but uneven.
Still a very good staggered seat with excellent Etihad service and bedding.
Aging reverse-herringbone but exceptionally well-executed EVA Royal Laurel soft product.
Excellent Apex window seats and solid Gulf service; staggered 2-2-2 layout.
Among the best transatlantic narrow-body enclosed suites; strong Iberia bedding.
Private narrow-body suite with excellent food and a comfortable flat bed.
Modern direct-aisle Allegris seat with useful cabin variants; solid LH ground.
Good all-aisle seat and exceptional SQ service; tighter footwells than long-haul business.
Major privacy, storage and bed-width upgrade over legacy Business Premier herringbone.
Adient Ascent door suites (ex-Hawaiian Leihōkū) now on Alaska long-haul; soft product still maturing.
Good bedding and privacy shell; no door and a narrower bed than Delta One Suite.

Modern door suite and good bed; LATAM retrofit footprint still limited versus fleet size.
Modern door suite and better tech; Elevated Polaris service remains variable.
Private Upper Class suite and social cabin; footwell somewhat tight versus peers.
Strong couples product with lowering divider and good Senses Double Seat bed space.

Excellent bed and bedding with strong Qantas lounge access; staggered Business Suite layout.
Direct-aisle business plus some of the best business-class catering in the sky.

Comfortable staggered suite plus onboard lounge; some Qantas fleet variability.
Excellent fleetwide Polaris seat consistency and bedding; service remains variable.

Excellent modern enclosed suite hard product on a tiny Ethiopian subfleet.
Stelia Solstys 180° with aisle access; open staggered cabin—no Next suite doors.
Strong conventional reverse-herringbone with good KLM fleet consistency.
Good conventional reverse-herringbone with Qatar soft product; older versus Qsuite.

Reliable staggered product with good Qantas sleep quality and bedding.

Good conventional all-aisle reverse-herringbone with strong AF soft product.
Strong conventional reverse-herringbone with broad American Flagship route coverage.
Good 1-2-1 all-aisle seat, tighter than JAL’s Apex window product.
Consistent all-aisle SAS fleet, good bedding and Scandinavian design.
Comfortable modern reverse-herringbone with warm Fiji Airways service.
Stylish direct-aisle cabin, strong Italian catering and a good flat bed.
Good throne seats and excellent Malaysian catering; not fully door-suited.
Real flat bed and excellent SQ service; staggered narrow-body aisle access varies.
